name: gh-account-guard
description: Asks before a gh or git push call runs on a GitHub account other than the one the repo's owner needs, and offers to switch.

rules.title: Account rules
rules.description: Which account each repo owner needs: account=owner,owner; account=owner. Owners are GitHub users or orgs, matched without case.

tokenOwners.title: Token owners
tokenOwners.description: Owners a GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN in the environment may reach, comma-separated. A token call to any other owner is held.
